# DizitalAdda — full reference

> DizitalAdda (DA DigitalAdda Innovations Pvt. Ltd.) is a career-skills training institute in Greater Kailash II, New Delhi, India. It teaches digital marketing, generative AI, data analytics, data science, machine learning, cyber security, web development and design through classroom, live-online and hybrid courses, with live projects and placement assistance.

This file lists every public page on https://dizitaladda.com with a short description, for language models and AI search tools. Shorter version: [llms.txt](https://dizitaladda.com/llms.txt). Last updated: 2026-10-31.

## Organisation

- Brand name: DizitalAdda (sometimes written "Dizital Adda")
- Legal entity: DA DigitalAdda Innovations Pvt. Ltd.
- Founded: 2009
- Campus: 2nd Floor, Spacetime Management Pvt Ltd Design House, behind Savitri Cinema Complex, Greater Kailash II, Chittaranjan Park, New Delhi, Delhi 110048, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91-8810606010  
- Email: info@dizitaladda.com
- Study modes: classroom (Greater Kailash II campus), live online, and hybrid
- Batch timings: morning, afternoon, evening and weekend batches
- Payment: EMI / instalment options available
- Fees: vary by course and level; confirm the current fee on the course page or with admissions
- Free demo class: available online or at the campus
- Website: https://dizitaladda.com/
- Social profiles: [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/dizitaladda01), [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/official_dizital_adda), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/dizitaladda), [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@DizitalAdda), [X (Twitter)](https://x.com/dizitaladda)

## How to choose a digital marketing course

| Course | Duration | Best for |
|---|---|---|
| [Beginners](https://dizitaladda.com/courses/digital-marketing-for-beginners) | 3 months | No prior experience; students after Class 12 |
| [Working Professionals](https://dizitaladda.com/courses/digital-marketing-for-professional) | 4 months | No prior experience; evening and weekend batches |
| [Advanced](https://dizitaladda.com/courses/advanced-digital-marketing-course) | 6 months |No prior experience, Graduates and career switchers who want hands-on campaign skills |
| [Expert](https://dizitaladda.com/courses/expert-digital-marketing-course) | 12 months | A complete programme from fundamentals to strategy |

All four are available in the classroom and live online. The degree and post-graduation programmes are delivered with partner universities.

## Courses

Course index: https://dizitaladda.com/courses/

### Digital marketing

#### Digital Marketing for Beginners

- URL: https://dizitaladda.com/courses/digital-marketing-for-beginners
- Duration: 3 months
- Entry-level course for people with no prior experience. Covers SEO, social media marketing, Google Ads, Meta Ads, email and content marketing, Google Analytics and AI marketing tools. Open to anyone who has passed Class 12; no degree or technical background needed. Online and classroom modes.

#### Digital Marketing for Working Professionals

- URL: https://dizitaladda.com/courses/digital-marketing-for-professional
- Duration: 4 months
- Part-time course with evening and weekend batches for people who are working. Covers SEO, SEM, social media, paid ads and analytics with hands-on projects; suits career switchers and business owners. Live classes with recordings; online and classroom modes.

#### Advanced Digital Marketing Course

- URL: https://dizitaladda.com/courses/advanced-digital-marketing-course
- Duration: 6 months (144+ hours, 60 modules)
- Execution-level training in paid ads, SEO, analytics and AI tools. Covers SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, content and email marketing, e-commerce strategy, performance marketing and AI marketing tools, applied on live brand campaigns, plus a paid in-house internship. Online and classroom modes.

#### Expert Digital Marketing Course

- URL: https://dizitaladda.com/courses/expert-digital-marketing-course
- Duration: 12 months
- The most comprehensive digital marketing programme, from fundamentals to strategy. Covers SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, analytics, performance marketing, AI tools and marketing strategy through live projects and an internship. Suited to career starters, freelancers and business owners.

### Generative AI

#### Advanced Certification in Generative AI & Prompt Engineering

- URL: https://dizitaladda.com/courses/advanced-certification-in-genai-and-prompt-engineering
- Duration: 6 months
- Practical generative-AI and prompt-engineering skills. Covers ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, LangChain, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), Hugging Face, Streamlit and vector databases.

#### Diploma in Generative AI & Prompt Engineering

- URL: https://dizitaladda.com/courses/diploma-in-genai-and-prompt-engineering
- Duration: 12 months
- Extended generative-AI programme including model building and deployment. Covers ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, LangChain, RAG, deep learning, transformers, MLOps and cloud deployment.

### Data analytics and data science

#### Certification in Data Analytics & AI

- URL: https://dizitaladda.com/courses/certification-in-data-analytics-and-ai
- Duration: 3 months
- Short job-focused analytics course. Covers Excel, SQL, Python and Power BI, with a portfolio of projects.

#### Advanced Certification in Data Analytics & AI

- URL: https://dizitaladda.com/courses/advanced-certification-in-data-analytics-and-ai
- Duration: see course page
- Intermediate data-analytics certification. Covers Excel, SQL, Python and analytics tools.

#### Diploma in Data Analytics & AI

- URL: https://dizitaladda.com/courses/diploma-in-data-analytics-and-ai
- Duration: 12 months (288 hours, hybrid)
- Full data-analytics stack from spreadsheets to Python. Covers Excel, Power Query, SQL, Power BI, DAX, Tableau, Python, Pandas, statistics, machine-learning fundamentals and AI tools.

#### Advanced Certification in Data Science & AI

- URL: https://dizitaladda.com/courses/advanced-certification-in-data-science-and-ai
- Duration: 6 months
- Data science with machine learning and deployment. Covers Python, SQL, machine learning, deep learning and cloud deployment using Scikit-learn, TensorFlow and Power BI.

#### Diploma in Data Science & AI

- URL: https://dizitaladda.com/courses/diploma-in-data-science-and-ai
- Duration: 12 months (288 hours, hybrid)
- Complete data-science pipeline. Covers Python, SQL, Power BI, machine learning, deep learning, big data with PySpark, MLOps and deployment on AWS, GCP and Azure.

### Machine learning and AI

#### Advanced Certification in Machine Learning & AI

- URL: https://dizitaladda.com/courses/advanced-certification-in-machine-learning-and-ai
- Duration: 6 months (144 hours)
- Job-ready machine learning and AI. Covers Python, TensorFlow, deep learning, NLP, computer vision, MLOps and model deployment.

#### Diploma in Machine Learning & AI

- URL: https://dizitaladda.com/courses/diploma-in-machine-learning-and-ai
- Duration: 12 months
- In-depth machine learning and deep learning. Covers Python, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, CNNs, RNNs, NLP, transformers, XGBoost, MLOps and computer vision.

### Cyber security, ethical hacking and digital forensics

#### Foundation in Cyber Security & Ethical Hacking

- URL: https://dizitaladda.com/courses/foundation-in-cyber-security-and-ethical-hacking
- Duration: 4 months (96 hours)
- Beginner-friendly start in cyber security. Covers Python, networking, Linux, ethical hacking, Kali Linux, Metasploit and Wireshark.

#### Advanced Certification in Cyber Security & Ethical Hacking

- URL: https://dizitaladda.com/courses/advanced-certification-in-cyber-security-and-ethical-hacking
- Duration: 6 months
- Vulnerability assessment, penetration testing and forensics. Covers VAPT, digital forensics, Python and ethical hacking with Metasploit, Nessus, OpenVAS and the OWASP Top 10.

#### Expert Training in Cyber Security & Ethical Hacking

- URL: https://dizitaladda.com/courses/expert-training-in-cyber-security-and-ethical-hacking
- Duration: 12 months (288 hours, hybrid)
- Advanced, broad cyber-security programme. Covers VAPT, web and mobile application penetration testing, AWS cloud security, IoT security, malware analysis, digital forensics, SIEM and EDR.

#### Certification in Digital Forensics & Cyber Investigation

- URL: https://dizitaladda.com/courses/certification-in-digital-forensic-and-cyber-investigation
- Duration: 4 months (96 hours, hybrid)
- Digital evidence and cybercrime investigation. Covers evidence collection, mobile and memory forensics and investigation using Autopsy, FTK Imager, Volatility, Cellebrite, EnCase and X-Ways.

#### Digital Forensics Course

- URL: https://dizitaladda.com/courses/digital-forensics-course
- Duration: 2 months
- Short intensive forensics course. Case-study projects with certification.

### Software and web development

#### Diploma in Computer Software & Technology

- URL: https://dizitaladda.com/courses/diploma-in-computer-software-and-technology
- Duration: 12 months
- Programming and web development for beginners. Covers Python, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, React, Node.js, MySQL, MongoDB and AI tools.

### Design and video

#### Graphic Design & Motion Graphics

- URL: https://dizitaladda.com/courses/graphic-design-and-motion-graphics

#### Graphic Design & Professional Video Editing

- Duration: 6 months
- Design plus video editing. Covers Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects and Canva.

#### UI/UX Design Course

- URL: https://dizitaladda.com/courses/ui-ux-design-course

- User-interface and user-experience design. Practical UI/UX design training for students and career switchers.

## Frequently asked questions

**Do I need a degree or technical background?** No. Anyone who has passed Class 12 can join the digital marketing courses; trainers start from the basics. Data, AI and cyber security courses start with fundamentals, and basic programming knowledge helps.

**Are classes online or offline?** Both. Classes are held at the Greater Kailash II campus and live online; online sessions are recorded so students can revise.

**What are the batch timings?** Morning, afternoon, evening and weekend batches are available.

**Is there an internship?** Digital marketing students can do an in-house internship on real client campaigns at DizitalAdda's agency; the course page says which levels include it.

**Which certificates do students receive?** A DizitalAdda course certificate, plus guidance for industry certifications such as Google Ads, Google Analytics, Meta Blueprint and HubSpot.

**Is placement help provided?** Yes. Placement assistance includes resume building, LinkedIn optimisation, mock interviews and introductions to hiring companies. It is assistance, not a guaranteed job.

**How much do the courses cost?** Fees depend on the course and level, and EMI options are available. Call +91-8810606010 or book a free counselling session for the current fee.

**Can I attend a demo class first?** Yes. A free demo class is available online or at the campus.
